data.name: Carbon Bank
data.description: Carbon Bank is a UK CDR project developer based in Stroud, Gloucestershire and part of the Green Britain Group (sister to Ecotricity and Forest Green Rovers, led by Dale Vince OBE). It operates an enhanced rock weathering project in Northumberland using local basalt quarry material spread on farmland, and is developing UK afforestation/nature-recovery projects. The company sells high-quality carbon credits and explicitly will not sell to heavy polluting industries.
